entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Support! Get me to support! This is unbelievable.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been trying to return this VeloBand Pulse for two weeks! I want my money back, now!
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

The issue is your company! I tried to return this thing on day nine, well within whatever ridiculous window you have, and your whole system was down! It was a complete website error, I couldn't get the page to load, and I certainly couldn't print a return label.

I'm sorry to hear you experienced that frustration. I can definitely investigate the return eligibility for you. Could I please get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

It's angrycustomer@email.com. And you better investigate it quickly. I even took a screenshot of the error page! If you don't fix this, I'm getting a manager and leaving a review on every website I can find.
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your account... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. That would make it 22 days ago.
I TOLD YOU, I tried to return it when your website was broken! This is on you, not me. Are you going to give me my refund or not?

Yes, I understand completely. Let me just check our policy... Okay. I see here that our return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 22, you are well within that timeframe. My apologies for the trouble the website caused.
Oh. Ninety days? Well... good. So you're processing the return then?

Absolutely. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Once we receive the device, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Okay. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
